Simply talk to the receptionist in the lobby to get started and rent a room.</p><p class="bb_paragraph"><img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b0111b1/rust_apartment_complex_1080-7.jpg style=box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;" crossorigin="anonymous" /></p><p class="bb_paragraph"><img src="https://files.facepunch.com/Alistair/102/07/2026/7f63/rust_apartment_complex_1080-14.jpg style=box-sizing: inherit; max-height: 250px; max-width: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: center center; flex-grow: 1; margin: 16px auto; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); width: 367px; height: 150px; display: block;" crossorigin="anonymous" /><img src="https://files.facepunch.com/Alistair/102/07/2026/4k84/rust_apartment_complex_1080-15.jpg style=box-sizing: inherit; max-height: 250px; max-width: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: center center; flex-grow: 1; margin: 16px auto; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); width: 367px; height: 150px; display: block;" crossorigin="anonymous" /></p><p class="bb_paragraph">There are options for every budget, from the basement to the penthouse. Palworld 1.0 is here!</p><p class="bb_paragraph"></p><p class="bb_paragraph">Sunreach, a mysterious new island floating in the sky…The World Tree, the heart of the Palworld story…Palpagos has grown, and a new adventure awaits.</p><p class="bb_paragraph">Palworld 1.0 adds 72 new Pals to the world, bringing the total number of Pals up to an incredible 287! </p><p class="bb_paragraph"></p><p class="bb_paragraph">Palworld 1.0 also adds new ways to strengthen your Pals through <b>Awakening</b> and <b>Mutation</b>, rebalanced stats and abilities for all Pals, and large-scale overhauls across many aspects of the game, including base building, multiplayer, and graphics.</p><p class="bb_paragraph"></p><p class="bb_paragraph">The journey that began in Early Access reaches its climax, and from here, a new Palworld begins.</p><p class="bb_paragraph"></p><div class="bb_h2"><b>▼ New Areas & World Improvements</b></div><div class="bb_h3"><b>● Sunreach</b></div><p class="bb_paragr
